newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico bourse inches up to new unofficial record.
newsitem.headline: Mexico bourse inches up to new unofficial record.

text.p: Mexican stocks pared earlier gains on profit-taking but still managed to close higher and chalk up their third record close in a row on Friday.
Dealers and analysts said heavy participation by foreign investors moved the market, which had gained in earlier trade as fears of forthcoming U.S. interest rate hikes subsided.
Preliminary closing figures placed leading IPC share index .MXX up 5.76 points, or 0.14 percent, at 4,245.78.
